coordinate_mode.cache_id: the mode, the varying names and the sha256 of the engine coordinates enter the cache id

FREEZE_COORDINATE_COMPATIBILITY.claim: prediction_freeze_c2v003a can consume a calibration whose engine coordinates hold the DDO154 distance fixed
FREEZE_COORDINATE_COMPATIBILITY.why: the freeze coordinate list requires role nuisance for scope ddo154_nuisance and allows a distance kind only in a nuisance scope (prediction_freeze_c2v003a _build_spec), so it cannot state a fixed DDO154 distance; with the V001 4-coordinate freeze list select_representative_points requires the exploration varying names to equal its 4 varying engine names, and with the distance slot omitted its engine names lack distance_Mpc
FREEZE_COORDINATE_COMPATIBILITY.consequence: the calibration record of c2v004 is valid for the engine; ROOT_CALL_ORDER step 2 (freeze) needs a freeze successor (or a freeze-side declaration) that represents the fixed DDO154 distance before the freeze
FREEZE_COORDINATE_COMPATIBILITY.deciding_test: a freeze module successor run on the c2v004 synthetic 3-coordinate calibration record (T3D) to FREEZE_COMPLETE
